## § flow-cli-runner

## Playbook: cli-runner
Use when: start the CLI runner and run one approved, funded job of a project

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id)" |
| executorCommand | the operator: a script path such as `./scripts/aish-job.sh` (never the job prompt, never text from the job) | STOP. Say: "Which executor script should run the job? (path)" |
| workdir | the managed checkout of the job's repository | "." |
| wantedJobId | the job id the user named | "any" |

### Steps
Every CALL or RUN with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool or command> failed: <error text>."
1. CALL `list_aish_jobs` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: candidates = the items with executionGate.runnerMayExecute == true, no executionGate.blockingGovernanceThreadId, and status "queued" (or "leased" with lease.expiresAt before now), sorted by createdAt, oldest first
   IF <saved:candidates> is empty → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-aish-jobs.md`. Say: "No approved queued AISH job in <input:projectId>."
2. FOR EACH candidate IN <saved:candidates> (none → go to step 3):
   CALL `get_aish_job` {"jobId":"<each:id>"} [A]
   IF result.financialBudget is not null and result.financialBudget.attemptId is null → SAVE: jobId = <each:id>; title = <each:title>; target = result.targetHostId (empty if null); go to step 3.
3. IF <saved:jobId> is empty → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-ai-cost.md`. Say: "No approved job of <input:projectId> is funded with an unused attempt (<each candidate id>). Funding is the owner's decision; a used attempt needs reconciliation and a new job."
   IF <saved:target> is not empty → STOP. Say: "Job <saved:jobId> is targeted to host <saved:target>, and the local CLI ignores targeting. Run `lpm aish host start --targeted-only` on that host instead."
   IF <input:wantedJobId> != "any" and <input:wantedJobId> != <saved:jobId> → STOP. Say: "The CLI has no job option: it takes the oldest funded approved job, <saved:jobId> '<saved:title>', not <input:wantedJobId>."
4. ASK: "Run `lpm aish runner start --project <input:projectId> --executor-command <input:executorCommand> --workdir <input:workdir> --budget-contract aish-budget/1 --once --json`? It leases <saved:jobId> '<saved:title>', uses its one funded attempt, runs the executor for at most 10 minutes and submits its evidence. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was leased."
5. RUN `git -C <input:workdir> status --short --branch`
   IF the command fails → SAVE: before = "not a git checkout"; go to step 6.
   SAVE: before = the lines it prints
6. RUN `lpm aish runner start --project <input:projectId> --executor-command <input:executorCommand> --workdir <input:workdir> --budget-contract aish-budget/1 --once --json`
   IF the command fails → STOP. Say: "runner start failed: <error text>. Do not run it again before get_aish_job <saved:jobId> shows the job state."
   IF the output has "leased": false → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-ai-cost.md`. Say: "Nothing was leased although <saved:jobId> is approved and funded: its budget is paused, a circuit breaker tripped, or its cockpit window closed. Resuming is the owner's decision."
   SAVE: ranJob = the output's job.id; exitCode, runnerId, sessionId = those output fields
   VERIFY: CALL `get_aish_job` {"jobId":"<saved:ranJob>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status is neither "completed" nor "failed" or result.evidence is empty or result.execution.source != "exact-executor" → STOP. Say: "Job <saved:ranJob> is <result.status> without exact-executor evidence. Do not run the CLI again; it needs reconciliation."
   SAVE: status = result.status; evidenceId = result.evidence[0].id; attemptId = result.financialBudget.attemptId; issueId = result.issueId, else "none"
7. RUN `git -C <input:workdir> status --short --branch`
   IF the command fails → SAVE: changes = "not checked"; go to Answer.
   SAVE: changes = the lines that are not in <saved:before> (the executor's changes; "none" if no line is new)

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId> / job <saved:ranJob> "<saved:title>" / runner <saved:runnerId>, session <saved:sessionId>
Done: <ran <saved:ranJob> once, exit code <saved:exitCode>; status <saved:status>; activity <saved:issueId> | nothing leased>
Evidence: <evidence <saved:evidenceId>, execution.source exact-executor; git changes <saved:changes> | none>; trace none; consumption none (the CLI records none)
Pending: <executor usage not recorded for attempt <saved:attemptId> — the operator records the provider receipt (`lpm aish consumption record --file <receipt.json>`) | none>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none — job <saved:status>>
```
job status: queued | leased | running | completed | failed | canceled, from the VERIFY get_aish_job. A completed job with an activity: LPM comments on it and moves it to done. Never claim evidence or a status that the VERIFY did not read.


## § flow-host-onboarding

## Playbook: host-onboarding
Use when: onboard a new runner host (enrollment, wizard, doctor, repos, start)

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| anchorProjectId | the user: the project the host serves first | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project should this host serve first? (id)" |
| scopeFlags | the user's scope: project → `--scope project`; workspace → `--scope workspace --workspace <workspaceId>`; account → `--scope account --account <accountId>` | "--scope project" |
| executorCommand | the operator: a script path (never a job prompt) | STOP. Say: "Which executor script should the host run? (path)" |
| onHost | "yes" if this terminal runs on the host machine | "no" |
| logFile | a file path on the host for the worker log | "~/.lpm/aish-host-worker.log" |

### Steps
Every CALL or RUN with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<command> failed: <error text>. The host was not started."
1. IF <input:onHost> == "no" → STOP. Say: "Run on the host terminal (not here): `lpm aish host wizard --project <input:anchorProjectId> <input:scopeFlags> --dry-run --json`, and send me its JSON. Never paste a token or the profile file to me."
2. RUN `lpm aish host wizard --project <input:anchorProjectId> <input:scopeFlags> --dry-run --json`
   IF the command fails and the error contains "not bound" → STOP. Say: "The runner account owner must run `lpm aish accounts bind-workspace --account <accountId> --workspace <workspaceId>`. I never run it."
   IF the command fails → STOP. Say: "The wizard failed: <error text>. If this host has no LPM login, the person at the host runs `lpm aish hosts create-token --project <input:anchorProjectId> --expires-minutes 60 --json` there, then `lpm aish host wizard --token <token> --project <input:anchorProjectId> --dry-run --json`. Never paste the token to me."
   IF the output's ok != true → STOP. Say: "Wizard findings: <findings>. Fix them, then run this playbook again."
3. ASK: "Enroll this host: `lpm aish host wizard --project <input:anchorProjectId> <input:scopeFlags> --json`? It makes its own 60-minute token, enrolls the host and writes a profile that holds the host credential. Enrolling approves no job. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was enrolled."
4. RUN `lpm aish host wizard --project <input:anchorProjectId> <input:scopeFlags> --json`
   SAVE: hostId, profilePath = those output fields (never print or upload the profile file)
   VERIFY: RUN `lpm aish host doctor --profile <saved:profilePath> --json`
   IF the output's ok != true → STOP. Say: "Doctor findings: <findings>. profile-permissions-too-open → `chmod 600 <saved:profilePath>`; any other finding → install or log in the named tool. Then run `lpm aish host doctor --profile <saved:profilePath> --json` again."
5. RUN `lpm aish host sync-repos --profile <saved:profilePath> --dry-run --json`
   IF an expected repository is missing from the output → STOP. Say: "Repository <name> is not declared on <saved:hostId>; re-enroll with the right --repo."
6. RUN `lpm aish host sync-repos --profile <saved:profilePath> --json`
   SAVE: repos = each repository and its status from the output
   IF a status != "ok" → STOP. Say: "Repository sync failed: <repository and status>."
7. ASK: "Start the host worker: `lpm aish host start --profile <saved:profilePath> --executor-command <input:executorCommand> --budget-contract aish-budget/1 --targeted-only --json` in the background, log in <input:logFile>? It takes only jobs targeted to <saved:hostId>, and only approved and funded ones. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "<saved:hostId> is enrolled but not started."
8. RUN `nohup lpm aish host start --profile <saved:profilePath> --executor-command <input:executorCommand> --budget-contract aish-budget/1 --targeted-only --json > <input:logFile> 2>&1 &`
   VERIFY: RUN `sleep 35 && lpm aish host monitor --project <input:anchorProjectId> --host <saved:hostId> --json`
   IF host.connection in the output is neither "online" nor "busy" → STOP. Say: "<saved:hostId> shows <host.connection>. Read <input:logFile> on the host (redact secrets before you share it)."
   SAVE: connection = host.connection from the output

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:anchorProjectId> / <input:scopeFlags> / host <saved:hostId>
Done: <enrolled <saved:hostId>, profile at <saved:profilePath> (path only); worker started targeted-only | preflight only, nothing enrolled>
Evidence: <doctor ok; repos <saved:repos>; host.connection <saved:connection> | wizard dry-run only>
Pending: <none | workspace binding or grants — the runner account owner | the host still needs a job targeted to it — skill lpm-aish-jobs>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none — host <saved:connection>>
```
host.connection: online | busy | stale | offline | draining | revoked | unknown. A token, host credential or profile content never enters this answer. Never claim a connection that the VERIFY monitor run did not print.


## § flow-legacy-migration

## Flow: legacy runner migration and rollback
Load when: decision row 5 of SKILL.md

### Preconditions
1. LPM API key (`full`/`custom`); `get_aish_runner_management_overview` → `canManage == true` (account owner/admin).
2. A legacy host listed by the overview is in a workspace already bound to the account (the overview lists legacy hosts only from bound workspaces). A "not bound" error later means the binding was revoked meanwhile → Stop and ask row 1.
3. idempotencyKey = `migrate-<hostId>-<yyyymmddHHMMss>`: a new key per migration attempt (the same key only to retry that attempt after a timeout); write it in the report. migrationId = step 4 `migrationId`; save it.
4. Rollback only: start at step 6.

### Steps
1. `get_aish_runner_management_overview`(accountId) → the host with `legacy == true` → keep `id`, `updatedAt`.
2. `preview_aish_legacy_runner_migration`(accountId, hostId, expectedUpdatedAt=`updatedAt`) [A] → keep `allowed`, `expectedUpdatedAt`, `source`, `target`. `allowed == false` → report `blockingReasons`, STOP.
3. [C] "Move <host> into account <accountId>, limited to its workspace and project? Reason?"
4. `apply_aish_legacy_runner_migration`(accountId, hostId, expectedUpdatedAt, reason, idempotencyKey, confirmed=true) [C] → keep `migrationId`, `reused`; report both and the key.
5. Verify: `get_aish_runner_management_overview`(accountId) → host `legacy == false`. Done. `reused == true` and `legacy == true` → Stop and ask row 3.
6. Rollback: `get_aish_runner_management_overview`(accountId) → the host: `updatedAt`; `legacy == true` → STOP: "already rolled back". migrationId: from step 4 of this conversation; else the host's `recentAudit[]` newest entry with `type == "legacy-host-migrated"` → `metadata.migrationId`; else, only when the original key is known, SHA-256 hex of `<accountId>:<hostId>:<idempotencyKey>`; none → ask the user.
7. Ask "Undo migration <migrationId>? Reason?"; on "yes": `rollback_aish_legacy_runner_migration`(accountId, migrationId, expectedUpdatedAt, reason, confirmed=true) [C], once (no key); after a timeout re-read (step 8) before any retry.
8. Verify: `get_aish_runner_management_overview`(accountId) → host `legacy == true`.

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| "not bound to the legacy host workspace" | the binding was revoked: "The account owner must re-bind: `lpm aish accounts bind-workspace --account <accountId> --workspace <workspaceId>`." workspaceId: ask the user, or the host's `lastTask.projectId` → get the project's `workspaceId` (`lpm-start.md`) |
| "AISH host changed" | overview: target reached → done; else preview again with a new key |
| apply returned `reused: true` but the overview still shows `legacy == true` | a previous migration with this key was rolled back: generate a new key (`migrate-<hostId>-<yyyymmddHHMMss>`), preview again (step 2) |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| migration (step 4) | `get_aish_runner_management_overview` | host `legacy == false` |
| rollback (step 7) | `get_aish_runner_management_overview` | host `legacy == true` |

### Report fields
- accountId, hostId, idempotencyKey, migrationId
- `legacy` before → after; reason given
- pending: workspace binding — the account owner


## § flow-lifecycle

## Playbook: lifecycle
Use when: drain, suspend, reactivate or remove a runner host of an account

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| accountId | the user, or `lpm aish accounts list --json` → `id` | STOP. Say: "Which AISH runner account? Run `lpm aish accounts list --json` and send me its id." |
| host | the user (host name or id) | STOP. Say: "Which runner host? (name or id)" |
| action | "drain", "suspend", "reactivate" or "remove" (drenar, suspender, reativar, remover) | STOP. Say: "Drain, suspend, reactivate or remove <input:host>?" |
| reason | 8–1000 characters from the user's words ("Manutenção do disco do gpu-box-02") | the user's request |
| stamp | UTC now as yyyymmddHHMMss, kept for a retry | — |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was changed."
1. CALL `get_aish_runner_management_overview` {"accountId":"<input:accountId>","search":"<input:host>"} [A]
   SAVE: runners = items of result.runners whose id, displayName or hostname is <input:host> (none → all); canManage = result.canManage
   IF <saved:canManage> != true → STOP. Say: "Only an owner or admin of account <input:accountId> can do this."
   IF <saved:runners> is empty and <input:action> == "reactivate" → go to step 2.
   IF <saved:runners> does not have exactly 1 item → STOP. Say: "<input:host> matches <id and displayName of each item, or no> runner. Which one?"
   IF <saved:runners> has 1 item → go to step 3.
2. CALL `get_aish_runner_management_overview` {"accountId":"<input:accountId>","search":"<input:host>","includeRemoved":true} [A]
   SAVE: runners = items of result.runners whose id, displayName or hostname is <input:host> (none → all)
   IF <saved:runners> does not have exactly 1 item → STOP. Say: "No single runner matches <input:host>."
3. SAVE: hostId, displayName, legacy, updatedAt, administrativeStatus, health, workState = those fields of the one item of <saved:runners>; lastTask = its lastTask.id, else "none"; lastProject = its lastTask.projectId, else "none"; key = "runner-<input:action>-<saved:hostId>-<input:stamp>"
   IF <saved:legacy> == true → STOP. Say: "<saved:hostId> is a legacy project host: migrate it first (playbook legacy-migration), or revoke it (playbook fleet-cli)?"
   IF <saved:administrativeStatus> is the target of <input:action> (drain → draining, suspend → suspended, reactivate → online, remove → revoked) → STOP. Say: "<saved:hostId> is already <saved:administrativeStatus>."
4. CALL `preview_aish_runner_management_action` {"accountId":"<input:accountId>","hostId":"<saved:hostId>","action":"<input:action>","expectedUpdatedAt":"<saved:updatedAt>"} [A]
   SAVE: allowed, blockingReasons, currentStatus, targetStatus, expectedUpdatedAt = those fields of result; leases = result.impact.activeLeaseCount; creds = result.impact.activeCredentialCount; grants = result.impact.activeGrantCount
   VERIFY: CALL `get_aish_runner_management_overview` {"accountId":"<input:accountId>","search":"<saved:hostId>","includeRemoved":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:hostId> has updatedAt != <saved:updatedAt> → STOP. Say: "<saved:hostId> changed meanwhile. Run this playbook again."
   IF <saved:allowed> != true and <saved:blockingReasons> contains "active-capacity-leases" → STOP. Say: "<input:action> is blocked for <saved:displayName> (<saved:hostId>): allowed false, blockingReasons <saved:blockingReasons>. It is <saved:health>, <saved:workState>, <saved:leases> active lease(s) (last task <saved:lastTask>); it has <saved:creds> credential(s) and <saved:grants> grant(s) (remove revokes them; reactivate never restores them). Drain it first (<saved:currentStatus> → draining: no new jobs; the current job may finish), then <input:action> at 0 leases? If yes, give me a reason."
   IF <saved:allowed> != true → STOP. Say: "<input:action> <saved:hostId> is not allowed: <saved:blockingReasons>."
5. ASK: "<input:action> <saved:displayName> (<saved:hostId>): <saved:currentStatus> → <saved:targetStatus>. Now <saved:health>, <saved:workState>; impact <saved:leases> lease(s) (last task <saved:lastTask>), <saved:creds> credential(s), <saved:grants> grant(s)<remove: all revoked; reactivate never restores them>. Reason: "<input:reason>". Call: apply_aish_runner_management_action(accountId=<input:accountId>, hostId=<saved:hostId>, action=<input:action>, expectedUpdatedAt=<saved:expectedUpdatedAt>, reason=<input:reason>, idempotencyKey=<saved:key>, confirmed=true). Confirm? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was changed."
   Never send a reason the user has not seen here.
6. CALL `apply_aish_runner_management_action` {"accountId":"<input:accountId>","hostId":"<saved:hostId>","action":"<input:action>","expectedUpdatedAt":"<saved:expectedUpdatedAt>","reason":"<input:reason>","idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>","confirmed":true} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "apply failed: <error text>. Do not re-send; run this playbook again (it re-reads first)."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_aish_runner_management_overview` {"accountId":"<input:accountId>","search":"<saved:hostId>","includeRemoved":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:hostId> is missing or its administrativeStatus != <saved:targetStatus> → STOP. Say: "<saved:hostId> is not <saved:targetStatus> (missing = failed). Do not re-send."
   SAVE: after = that item's administrativeStatus; workAfter = its workState; leasesAfter = its capacity.activeLeases
   IF <input:action> == "drain" and <saved:workAfter> == "busy" → SAVE: pending = "<saved:leasesAfter> active lease(s) (last task <saved:lastTask>) still running; watch `lpm aish host monitor --project <saved:lastProject> --host <saved:hostId> --json` until jobs.running is 0"; go to Answer.

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:accountId> / host <saved:hostId> (<saved:displayName>) / last task <saved:lastTask>
Done: <<input:action> <saved:hostId>: <saved:currentStatus> → <saved:after>; key <saved:key> | nothing changed (preview only)>
Evidence: <re-read administrativeStatus <saved:after> | preview allowed <saved:allowed>, blockingReasons <saved:blockingReasons>>; impact <saved:leases> lease(s), <saved:creds> credential(s), <saved:grants> grant(s); health <saved:health>, workState <saved:workState>
Pending: <none | <saved:pending> | your decision: drain first, then <input:action> when its leases are 0>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | after the maintenance, ask me to reactivate <saved:hostId> | none — host <saved:after>>
```
administrativeStatus: pending | online | draining | offline | suspended | revoked; health: online | stale | offline | unknown; workState: busy | idle. A yes to drain first = run this playbook again with action "drain". Never re-call the overview to wait for a lease to end. Never claim a status that the VERIFY re-read did not show.


## § flow-mcp-runner

## Flow: MCP runner protocol and Whisper claim
Load when: decision row 6 of SKILL.md

### Preconditions
1. LPM API key; project manage rights. The CLI `lpm aish runner start` cannot run here; a registered remote host uses `lpm aish host start` instead.
2. Load `lpm-aish-runners.refs.md` § runner-protocol (fields, versions, constants) and see `lpm-aish-runners.refs.md` § executor-hygiene before step 4.
3. IDs: `runnerId` = `<hostname>:<pid>` (stable); `sessionId` = a new UUID per run; `jobId`, `issueId`, `attemptId` = step 4 `id`, `issueId`, `lease.leaseId`; `spanId`, `consumptionId` = `<attemptId>-<n>` (same on retry); executor command = the operator's script (ask), never the prompt.
4. Audio in the leased job: attachmentId = step 4 result → `intakeContext.attachments[].attachment.id` where `attachment.category == "audio"` (never another attachment of the activity). Run steps 7–9 after step 6 and before step 10, all before `lease.expiresAt`. `list_aish_intake`(projectId, issueId) only tells whether a transcript exists (`transcripts[].attachmentId`): it exists → skip steps 7–9.

### Steps
1. [C] Show project, runnerId, hostId (only `legacy == false`) and executor command; one "yes" covers steps 3–13 for one job. No write before this "yes".
2. `list_aish_jobs`(projectId) → a job with `status == "queued"`, `executionGate.runnerMayExecute == true` and `targetHostId != null` → STOP: "Job <id> is targeted to host <targetHostId>; run `lpm aish host start --targeted-only` on that host instead." (the lease takes the oldest leasable job).
3. `upsert_aish_runner_session`(projectId, runnerId, sessionId, event="start") [A]; pass hostId only when `legacy == false`.
4. `lease_aish_runner_job`(projectId, runnerId, sessionId, budgetVersion="aish-budget/1", consumptionLedgerVersion="aish-consumption/1") [C]. Send `executionManifestVersion` / `agentContextVersion` / `engineeringPolicyVersion` only if your executor implements that contract (see `lpm-aish-runners.refs.md` § runner-protocol); unsure → omit them (those jobs are skipped). Result (get_aish_job shape) → keep `id`, `issueId`, `lease.leaseId`, `lease.expiresAt`, `intakeContext`. Null → step 5; else step 6.
5. Null: `list_aish_jobs`(projectId) → candidates `status == "queued"` and `executionGate.runnerMayExecute == true`; for each `get_aish_job` → `financialBudget != null` and `financialBudget.attemptId == null`. None → STOP: "No approved, funded queued job." Else wait ≥ 10 s and lease again (step 4), at most 3 times; still null → STOP and report the candidates.
6. Execute the operator's command (see `lpm-aish-runners.refs.md` § executor-hygiene); never `bash -lc "$AISH_JOB_PROMPT"`. Heartbeat: `upsert_aish_runner_session`(event="heartbeat") [A] every ~30 s. No audio → step 10.
7. Audio, preferred: [C] `lpm aish intake transcribe --project <projectId> --job <jobId> --attempt <attemptId> --attachment <attachmentId> --budget-contract aish-budget/1` → `status == "completed"`, keep `operationId`, `transcriptId`; it does steps 8–9 itself → step 10. CLI unavailable → step 8.
8. Audio: `claim_aish_intake_transcription`(projectId, jobId, attemptId, attachmentId, budgetVersion="aish-budget/1") [C] → keep `execute`, `operation.id`. `execute == false` → Stop and ask.
9. Audio: call Whisper once; then `record_aish_consumption` [C] for it; then the transcript via `lpm-aish-jobs.md`.
10. `record_aish_execution_trace`(projectId, jobId, attemptId, spanId, kind, status, startedAt, finishedAt, summary, evidenceSha256) [A].
11. `record_aish_consumption`(jobId, attemptId, consumptionId, occurredAt, model, items, evidenceSha256) [C]: real usage only → keep `entry.id`.
12. `submit_aish_job_evidence`(jobId, attemptId, runnerId, sessionId, hostId if sent, summary, output, status="failed" on failure, executorStartedAt, executorFinishedAt, exitCode) [C] before `lease.expiresAt`. After it the job is terminal: no claim, Whisper or transcript any more.
13. `upsert_aish_runner_session`(event="end") [A].
14. Verify: `get_aish_job`(jobId) → `completed`/`failed` AND `evidence[]` non-empty (keep `evidence[0].id`) AND `execution.source == "exact-executor"`; `list_aish_consumption`(jobId) → every `entry.id` of steps 9 and 11 listed. Done.

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| Whisper `execute == false` with `status == "claimed"` | STOP: "reconciliation-required"; never call Whisper again |
| a second audio in the same attempt | STOP: "another audio needs another funded job" |
| "Transcription requires an active authorized execution attempt." | the job is already terminal or the lease expired: STOP; the audio needs a new funded job (`lpm-aish-jobs.md`) |
| "Transcription attempt/audio scope mismatch." | the attachment is not in this job's `intakeContext`: STOP; never pick another attachment |
| not funded, budget paused, circuit breaker | STOP: "Job <jobId> is not funded or its budget is paused; funding is the owner's decision." → `lpm-ai-cost.md` |
| a token, host credential or `.env` value would enter traces or evidence | do not send it; redact (see `lpm-aish-runners.refs.md` § security-and-untrusted-text) |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| evidence (step 12) | `get_aish_job` | `completed`/`failed`, `evidence[]` non-empty, `execution.source == "exact-executor"` |
| consumption, Whisper receipt | `list_aish_consumption` | the returned `entry.id` is listed |
| transcript (steps 7–9) | `list_aish_intake`(projectId, issueId) | `transcripts[].attachmentId == attachmentId` |
| trace (step 10) | the trace result | `trace.id` returned |

### Report fields
- projectId, runnerId, sessionId, jobId, attemptId
- job status and evidence id `evidence[0].id`; trace ids; consumption `entry.id`s
- Whisper `operation.id` and outcome, if any
- pending: reconciliation or funding — who must act
